content:
OMC Tankers and Bruton Ltd split comments

Initially Bruton Ltd was a pure VLCC play company with 1 vessel in operation and 11 VLCC on order at NTS and Yantai Raffles shipyard in China with deliveries expected from Nov 26 to Aug 29.

In order to reduce discount to peers due to long time-difference of NB deliveries compared to dividend-capable vessels on the water, it was decided to spin off 8x VLCCs (4x NTS and 4x Yantai) to a separate company named OMC Tankers.
